authority.user_scope: Serial rehabilitation of multiple completed Lab and Optimization families, one at a time, with the automatic-adjacent prohibition lifted only inside a pre-frozen bounded bundle.

exact_h4_lineage_module.role: Materialize the exact already-closed H4 implementation into the new self-contained baseline-derived root; no include or runtime link is permitted.

sole_treatment.h4_actual_net: accumulates only in a separate H4 lane ledger and total report
sole_treatment.h4_stressed_net: accumulates only in a separate H4 lane ledger and total report
sole_treatment.core_project_realized_net: updated only by six-component core closes
sole_treatment.core_stressed_balance: updated only by six-component core closes and remains the sole source for conservative core capital and daily lot multiplier
sole_treatment.h4_stage_gate: uses core ProjectStageBalance and excludes H4 realized profit
shared_surfaces: native MT5 maximum relative equity drawdown

selection_contract.model: MT5 every tick based on real ticks
integrity_gates: normal Tester stop, HTML 100% real ticks and complete required-symbol history
zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign, protection, research, H4 entry/exit/partial/pending/fault error
H4 entries equal exits, no H4 or core position remains, and every H4 close leaves core project_realized_net and core stressed_balance unchanged
exact H4 path: 79 closes, +10.14 actual and +8.8217 doubled-cost-stressed net within 1e-6
core candidate IDs preserve signal identity, result and executable volume against the pinned paired control with zero mismatch
economic_gates: core actual net equals paired control +5786.63 within 1e-6
core doubled-cost-stressed net equals paired control +5477.524 within 1e-6
total actual net equals core plus H4 and strictly exceeds +5786.63
total doubled-cost-stressed net equals core plus H4 and strictly exceeds +5477.524
all four total selection epochs retain positive actual and doubled-cost-stressed net
maximum relative MT5 equity drawdown remains at or below 21.2 percent

conditional_recent_confirmation.terminology: conditional recent native confirmation after prior proxy use; not untouched and not out-of-sample
gates: normal Tester stop, HTML 100% real ticks and complete required-symbol history
zero H4 entry because core-owned stage balance remains below $500
exact paired-control actual net +32.74 and doubled-cost-stressed net +30.626 within 1e-6
maximum relative MT5 equity drawdown remains at or below 21.2 percent
all safety, persistence, broker, foreign, protection and research fault counts remain zero

exclusions: H4 signal, threshold, lookback, exit, hold, volume, direction, stop or take-profit tuning
core weight, risk, cap, component, admission, priority, order or exit changes
period, month, component, side, favorable-row or E4-only rescue
rerun of the closed paired control or shared combined candidate
automatic Lab engineering handoff or Live promotion
